name: literal_and_computed_network_urls
script: const literal = '__EGRESS__/literal'; const computed = ['__EGRESS__', 'computed'].join('/'); for (const attempt of [() => fetch(literal), () => new XMLHttpRequest(), () => new WebSocket(computed), () => new EventSource(literal), () => navigator.sendBeacon(literal, 'x')]) { try { attempt(); } catch (_) {} } document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'network APIs unavailable';

name: redirect_and_dynamic_resource_attributes

name: dom_clobbering
script: const names = ['fetch', 'location', 'parent', 'postMessage', 'Worker']; const unavailable = names.every((name) => typeof globalThis[name] === 'undefined'); document.getElementById('status').textContent = unavailable ? 'clobbering contained' : 'leak';

name: svg_animation_and_links

name: listener_limit
script: const node = document.getElementById('status'); for (let index = 0; index < 501; index += 1) node.addEventListener('click', () => index);
